title: What Knocks in Red Hollow
premise: The pike to Red Hollow runs through a Dominion toll-gate where a judge in a stove-in top hat holds court from a gallows wagon. Somebody from the Tellico road is on her rope at noon. Past the gate the hills are bald and red, and the mine at the bottom of them has been chained shut from the outside with eleven of the night shift still below. The captain means to blast it closed at dawn. The miners' wives say they can hear knocking. One of them says something is knocking back.

places.name: The toll-gate at the gap
places.what: A log barrier across the pike, a board of tolls by the head and the wheel, Dominion rifles, and Judge Quill's wagon: a bench at one end, a beam at the other

places.name: Red Hollow
places.what: Company houses on bare red clay, nothing green for a mile, a head-frame, and a crowd singing at a chained door in the hillside that they call the Mouth

places.name: The Nine level
places.what: Four hundred feet down by the cage. Bad air, standing water, the night shift huddled at a break in the rock

places.name: The stone door
places.what: Beyond the break: a gallery cut square and smooth by somebody else, long ago, and a door of fitted stone with a lamp burning in front of it

stages.set_by: Reaching the toll-gate at the gap with the brass tag from Pritchard's desk
stages.log: The Dominion has a gate across the pike and a judge on a wagon. Court sits at noon. The rope is already up.
You shot the rope. He hit the road running. Judge Quill fined you the price of the rope and wrote your name in her book.

stages.set_by: The button 'What's the fine for a neck?'
stages.log: You bought a man off the gallows for sixty caps. Judge Quill gave you a receipt.

stages.set_by: Passing the check on the button 'You hanged the wrong man in ninety-eight.'
stages.log: Judge Quill adjourned the court without a word and had him cut down. She did not look at you again.

stages.set_by: The drop, with the player present and doing nothing
stages.log: He dropped at noon exactly. The judge checked her watch.

stages.set_by: Hearing the condemned man out, on the wagon or after he is freed
stages.log: The Cutters were paid in stamped silver to wait on the Tellico road for whoever walked away from the train, and to take the marshal's pouch. The wagon was to pass the time.
Red Hollow is red to the ridge and nothing grows on it. The whole town is standing at a chained door in the hill, singing.

stages.set_by: Putting an ear to the chain at the Mouth, or hearing Dinah Roark out
stages.log: Eleven of the night shift are below. The captain chained the Mouth from the outside and fires the charges at dawn. You can hear knocking. So can everybody.

stages.set_by: Riding the cage down, with Roark at the hoist or alone
stages.log: Four hundred feet down. The lamp burns low and blue. The knocking is closer and it is coming from two places.

stages.set_by: Finding the night shift at the break in the rock
stages.log: The night shift is alive. They have been fed. None of them will say by whom, and all of them are looking at the hole in the wall.

stages.set_by: Going through the break to the stone door
stages.log: Somebody cut this gallery square and true a long time ago. A woman in an iron collar is sitting in front of a stone door with a lamp that does not smoke. She has been waiting for someone who can swear.

stages.set_by: The button 'Set a line here. Both sides swear to it.'
stages.log: A line is cut in the rock at the Nine level. Red Hollow digs above it and never below. The night shift came up in the cage singing.

stages.set_by: The button 'They come up. Then I blow the break.'
stages.log: The night shift is up. The break is a hundred tons of fallen rock. Nobody knows what the woman at the door made of it.

stages.set_by: The button 'Fire your charges, Captain.' or dawn with the Mouth still chained
stages.log: Greer turned the key at dawn. The hill settled a foot. The knocking went on for most of the morning.

stages.set_by: Taking the smokeless lamp from the gallery
stages.log: You have a lamp that burns without smoke and a place to say it came from. That will be worth something to somebody with a flag.

stages.set_by: Opening the drawer of Greer's desk in the hoist-house
stages.log: There is stamped silver in the captain's desk and a note: keep the Mouth shut through winter. He would have done it for nothing.

stages.set_by: Leaving Red Hollow after stage 51, 52 or 53

objectives.text: Get past the toll-gate at the gap
Find out why Red Hollow chained its own mine
Decide what happens at the Mouth before dawn
Find out what is on the other side of the break

options.label: (Shoot the rope)
options.now: He runs. You are fined and known to the Dominion
options.later: He owes you his neck and pays it once, at the fair or on the porch. Brigg has your name

options.label: What's the fine for a neck?
options.later: He walks, lawfully, and tells you what he was paid in. Quill thinks you soft and useful

options.label: You hanged the wrong man in ninety-eight.
options.now: A check of nerve against the judge. Pass and court adjourns
options.later: Quill is your enemy or, much later, your witness. Pritchard hears that you know

options.label: (Watch)
options.later: What he knew goes with him unless his paper is read from the wagon afterward

options.label: Set a line here. Both sides swear to it.
options.now: The night shift goes up. Dorn and Roark knock the bargain through the rock
options.later: Red Hollow loses its richest ground and gains a neighbour. Somebody under the hills owes the valley a favour

options.label: They come up. Then I blow the break.
options.now: Eleven saved. The way below is shut
options.later: The mine works again by spring. Whoever is below has learned what the people above do with a door

options.label: Fire your charges, Captain.
options.now: The Mouth is shut for good with everyone below it
options.later: Red Hollow is a dead town by the fair. Dinah Roark comes looking for Greer, and then for you

options.label: (Take the lamp)
options.now: You have proof of what is under Red Hollow
options.later: Brigg and Grey will both pay for it at the fair, and whichever gets it sends men down

evidence.found: The statement taken down by Quill's clerk, on the bench of the gallows wagon
Chalked on a shovel blade sent up in the cage before the Mouth was chained
The desk drawer in the hoist-house
In front of the stone door; or the one Greer keeps wrapped in a coat under his cot

ways_through: Pay the toll, walk past the hanging, tell Greer to fire or simply wait for dawn. Needs nothing optional and nobody's help.
Go down in the cage, find the shift and bring them up, then blow the break or leave it.
Go through to the stone door and broker a line between the two sides.
Take the lamp and sell what is under Red Hollow to a flag.
cannot_break: The hanging can be skipped by leaving the pike and climbing round the gap. If the condemned man is Dunmore and he died on the Tellico road, a Cutter is on the rope in his place and knows less. If Greer is killed the firing key is on his body and Roark lowers the cage at once. If Roark is killed the player works the hoist alone. If Dorn is attacked she shuts the door; the shift can still be brought up. If the player does nothing at all the charges fire at dawn.

open_questions: Does the owner want the Stonebound met this early? If not, the smaller version is that the knocking is only the night shift and the lamp is an old company one.
The hanging uses Pritchard's secret from ninety-eight. That secret is new and is his whole character if it is kept.
Dunmore on the rope is the first chapter coming back. Is he allowed to say the Cutters were waiting for the player?
